diagnosis: The checks C3, C4, C5, C6, and C7 all passed because the lone decision-maker had access to the same set of public facts and private facts as the agents who were supposed to provide the hidden information. Specifically, the decision-maker had access to 'S1', 'S2', 'S3', and 'S4', which included the necessary details to satisfy the conditions for these checks. For instance, the decisions to have no speeches, set the conversation duration to 180 minutes, use audio-only recording, place decorations on the west wall, ensure no open flames, and clear the south entrance route were all within the scope of the public facts and private facts available to the decision-maker.
